statistics_limitations: Conditional associations concern only this finite explicit case-record set and reviewed pathogen stratum, not infection incidence, individual risk, an outbreak diagnosis, or an intervention instruction.
No population denominator was supplied. Selected or observed patient counts are not a surveillance population denominator.
Records not meeting the declared eligibility requirements remain individually listed, with unknown and excluded categories separated; they are not normal or negative observations.
The entire declared department by window family is retained, including empty and fixed-margin comparisons. No candidate is dropped according to its observed count or p-value.
Adjustment applies only to this complete declared family. It does not control undisclosed data-dependent family selection or repeated analyses.
Current independent technical publication proves a declaration before this execution, not that the plan was chosen without seeing data, professional competence, or local clinical validation.
Case capture, reporting practices and classification changes can change the observed pattern. These comparisons do not distinguish those mechanisms from actual changes in infection.
Distinct subject tokens alone do not establish sampling independence; shared exposures, ascertainment and other dependencies still require domain validation.
Repeated eligible subject tokens prevent the independence assumption for this record-level method. In that case all counts remain, and the whole inference is unavailable rather than deduplicated.
Stored onset calendar dates are used literally; no UTC event-time or historical availability claim is added.
This pure evaluator proves mechanical bindings and arithmetic only; it does not authorize Source reads, prove Department identity, publish a Scenario, or enable clinical use.
source_limitations: Only all caller-declared InfectionCase roots for this explicit patient set and onset-date window are represented; no hospital-wide surveillance coverage is established.
Recorded workflow status is not a diagnosis, laboratory finding, independent case classification or resolution of infection.
Case classifications and local taxonomy codes are explicit human declarations against this exact definition; pure hashes and distinct actor IDs do not prove real publication or clinical validity.
Onset is a stored calendar date; legacy create/update clocks have unknown timezone and are not historical availability or UTC event timestamps.
No population denominator was provided; distinct selected or observed subjects must not become a denominator, rate, probability or outbreak determination.
Admission linkage, pathogen laboratory determination and validated signal modelling are not provided by the legacy table.
Multiple reports for the same patient remain distinct records; no duplicate-infection or repeat-event merging is performed.
HMAC tokens are pseudonymous technical references, not an anonymity guarantee; the private mapping key and original rows remain server-side.
This mechanical projection grants no clinical read, model execution, independent review, export or intervention permission.
